findings.reason: In the diff, Escape is handled only by <svelte:window on:keydown>, and .modal-content has tabindex=0 with on:keydown|stopPropagation. Once focus is in the dialog or on its close button, keydown stops at the dialog and never reaches the window.
findings.claim: Escape doesn't close the map dialog once focus is inside it, because the dialog stops keydown propagation before it reaches the window handler.
findings.evidence: The Escape handling is registered only as `<svelte:window on:keydown={handleKeydown} />` (line 50, handler at lines 31-35). The dialog element `.modal-content` has `tabindex="0"` and `on:keydown|stopPropagation` (lines 60-62). Clicking inside the dialog focuses it (it is the nearest focusable ancestor), so a later Escape keydown targets `.modal-content` or its children. stopPropagation then halts bubbling and the window handler never runs.
